verdict.rationale: Aircall's own marketing says calls, SMS and messaging live in one platform. It also describes a shared inbox that keeps every conversation visible to the team, and says note capture exists via AI Assistants and in power-dialer workflows. None of this explicitly shows calls and texts threaded under a single contact record with a unified history. Missing for 10: explicit per-contact threading of calls and texts, a documented contact-level history and notes view shared across the team, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a sales lead, calls and texts thread under a contact with notes and history the whole team sees

citations.quote: Calls, SMS, and messaging live in one platform, keeping every interaction connected to your CRM, help desk, and business tools.
A shared inbox keeps every conversation visible, giving your team the ability to collaborate in real time and step in without losing context.
AI Assistants capture notes, update CRM records, and create follow-up tasks automatically
with time between calls for notes and tags
